permission_mode.name: Permission Mode
permission_mode.hint: Keep deny_list (empty deny list = accept all). The only inbound sender is this PC's PTT anyway.

zh.name: 权限模式
zh.hint: 保持 deny_list（空黑名单 = 全部接受），本适配器唯一消息来源就是本机按键说话

zh.name: 私聊白名单
zh.hint: 黑名单模式下不生效

zh.name: 群聊白名单
zh.hint: 本适配器无群聊，不生效

zh.name: 群聊黑名单
zh.hint: 本适配器无群聊，不生效

user_deny_list.name: User deny list
user_deny_list.hint: Keep empty = accept all PTT input.

zh.name: 私聊黑名单
zh.hint: 保持为空 = 接受所有按键说话输入

owner_id.name: Owner session ID
owner_id.hint: Session id of the DM session (sid = <adapter name>:dm:<owner_id>). Change only if you know why.

zh.name: 主人会话ID
zh.hint: 私聊会话 ID（会话 = 适配器名:dm:此值），无特殊需要不要改

owner_nickname.name: Owner nickname
owner_nickname.hint: Nickname shown to the bot for PTT voice input.

zh.name: 主人昵称
zh.hint: bot 眼中语音输入者的昵称

ptt_mode.name: PTT mode
ptt_mode.hint: hold = talk while key is held; toggle = press once to start, press again to stop.

zh.name: 按键模式
zh.hint: hold = 按住说话；toggle = 按一下开始、再按一下结束

hotkey.name: Hotkey
hotkey.hint: Global hotkey: single key like 'b', combo like 'ctrl+shift+v', or mouse side buttons 'x2'/'x3'. OVR Advanced Settings Key Press can map a VR controller button to this same key.

zh.name: 热键
zh.hint: 全局热键：单键如 b，组合如 ctrl+shift+v，或鼠标侧键 x2/x3。VR 手柄可用 OVR Advanced Settings 的 Key Press 映射到同一按键

hotkey_require_focus.name: Only when VRChat focused
hotkey_require_focus.hint: When on, the hotkey only starts recording if the focused window is VRChat. Typing B in other apps will not trigger PTT.

zh.name: 仅 VRChat 前台时触发
zh.hint: 开启后，只有焦点窗口是 VRChat 时热键才开始录音，其他软件里打字按 B 不会误触发

hotkey_focus_process.name: Focus process name
hotkey_focus_process.hint: Foreground process name that unlocks the hotkey (usually VRChat.exe).

zh.name: 前台进程名
zh.hint: 视为「游戏内」的前台进程名，一般是 VRChat.exe

mic_device.name: Microphone device
mic_device.default: 【系统默认】跟随 Windows 设置
mic_device.hint: Dropdown populated at plugin start with this PC's 16 kHz-capable input devices (first item = follow the Windows default device). After refreshing the list on the status page, restart the bot (or disable/enable the plugin) for the dropdown to update. If a configured device is not found when recording starts, the system default is used and a warning shows on the status page.

zh.name: 麦克风设备
zh.hint: 下拉列表由插件启动时自动检测（本机可用 16 kHz 的输入设备），首项 = 跟随 Windows 系统默认。在状态页刷新列表后，需重启 bot（或禁用/启用插件）下拉才会更新；录音时找不到已配置的设备会自动回退系统默认并在状态页提示

mic_gain.name: Microphone gain
mic_gain.hint: Software gain applied to the mic signal before ASR: 1.0 = untouched, 2-5 helps quiet microphones. Too high clips (see the level meter on the status page).

zh.name: 麦克风增益
zh.hint: 麦克风增益倍数；1.0=原样，2~5 适合电平偏低的麦克风，过高会削波（可在状态页电平表看到 clipping 提示）

max_record_seconds.name: Max recording seconds
max_record_seconds.hint: Recording is force-stopped after this many seconds.

zh.name: 最长录音秒数
zh.hint: 超时自动结束录音

asr_backend.name: ASR backend
asr_backend.hint: local = faster-whisper on this PC; cloud = speech-to-text via KiraAI providers (default STT, or the model selected below).

zh.name: 语音识别后端
zh.hint: local = 本机 faster-whisper；cloud = 走 KiraAI 的语音识别（默认 STT 模型，或下面指定的模型）

cloud_stt_model.name: Cloud STT model
cloud_stt_model.hint: Only used when ASR backend = cloud. Leave empty to use KiraAI's default STT model (recommended). Pick another STT model here to override just for this adapter.

zh.name: 云端语音识别模型
zh.hint: 仅在识别后端 = cloud 时生效。留空 = 使用 KiraAI 全局默认 STT（推荐）；也可在此单独指定其他已配置的 STT 模型

whisper_model.name: Whisper model
whisper_model.hint: faster-whisper model name or local path. large-v3-turbo fits a 4060 8G; use 'medium'/'small' if VR frames drop.

zh.name: Whisper 模型
zh.hint: 模型名或本地路径。4060 8G 建议 large-v3-turbo；VR 里掉帧换 medium/small

zh.name: 识别语言
zh.hint: 语言代码或 auto

whisper_compute.name: Whisper compute type
whisper_compute.hint: int8_float16 for GPU; falls back to CPU int8 automatically if CUDA libs are missing.

zh.name: 计算精度
zh.hint: GPU 用 int8_float16；CUDA 库缺失时自动回退 CPU int8

hf_endpoint.name: HuggingFace endpoint
hf_endpoint.hint: Used when downloading whisper models. Keep the CN mirror if huggingface.co is unreachable; set empty to use the official hub.

zh.name: HuggingFace 镜像
zh.hint: 下载 whisper 模型用的 Hub 地址。国内默认 hf-mirror.com；若可直连官方源可清空

whisper_download_root.name: Whisper download root
whisper_download_root.hint: Optional local folder for model files (leave empty to use the default HF cache).

zh.name: 模型下载目录
zh.hint: 模型文件存放目录；留空使用 HuggingFace 默认缓存

asr_load_timeout_seconds.name: ASR load timeout (seconds)
asr_load_timeout_seconds.hint: Max wait for first-time model download/load. On timeout the adapter recovers to idle.

zh.name: 模型加载超时（秒）
zh.hint: 首次下载/加载 whisper 模型的最长等待；超时后自动回到 idle，避免卡死

osc_in_port.name: VRChat OSC input port
osc_in_port.hint: UDP port VRChat listens on for chatbox commands.

zh.name: VRChat OSC 入站端口
zh.hint: VRChat 接收聊天框消息的 UDP 端口

send_interval.name: Segment interval (seconds)
send_interval.hint: Minimum seconds between chatbox segments (short lines). Long lines wait longer based on reading speed. VRChat drops messages beyond 5 per 5s, keep >= 1.

zh.name: 分段间隔（秒）
zh.hint: 聊天框分段发送的最小间隔（短句）。长句会按阅读速度自动拉长。VRChat 限制 5 秒内最多 5 条，不要低于 1

read_chars_per_second.name: Reading speed (chars/sec)
read_chars_per_second.hint: Used to space multi-segment replies: gap ≈ length / this value, clamped to [send_interval, max_segment_interval]. 5 suits casual Chinese reading.

zh.name: 阅读速度（字/秒）
zh.hint: 多段回复的间隔按「段字数 ÷ 此值」估算，限制在 [分段间隔, 最大分段间隔] 之间。中文休闲阅读约 5

max_segment_interval.name: Max segment interval (seconds)
max_segment_interval.hint: Upper bound for the reading-time gap between segments.

zh.name: 最大分段间隔（秒）
zh.hint: 按阅读速度拉长后的间隔上限

reply_prefix.name: Reply prefix
reply_prefix.hint: Prefixed to every chatbox segment (e.g. 'yuki：'). Chatbox lines appear under the local player's name — the prefix marks bot replies. Strongly recommended. Leave empty to disable.

zh.name: 回复前缀
zh.hint: 每条聊天框消息前加上此前缀（如 yuki：）。聊天框会挂在本机玩家名下，前缀用来区分 bot 回复和你自己打的字，强烈建议填写。留空则不加

send_timeout_seconds.name: Pipeline reply timeout (seconds)
send_timeout_seconds.hint: If the bot pipeline never sends a reply within this window, the adapter returns to idle so the next PTT press is accepted.

zh.name: 回复超时（秒）
zh.hint: 若管线在此时间内没有回发消息，适配器自动回到 idle，避免卡死无法再次说话

typing_indicator.name: Typing indicator
typing_indicator.hint: Show the '...' typing indicator while transcribing/thinking.

zh.name: 打字指示器
zh.hint: 识别/思考期间在聊天框显示省略号状态

log_conversations.name: Log conversations
log_conversations.hint: Append each recognized text and reply to plugin_data/vrclink/conversations.jsonl.

zh.name: 记录对话
zh.hint: 把识别文本与回复追加到 plugin_data/vrclink/conversations.jsonl
